Class Listener

java.lang.Object
User
Listener
public class Listener extends User
Class representing a Listener type of User. Extends User class. Listeners store an ArrayList of Playlists representing their library. Methods here serve to modify that library's content.

    • getPlaylistAtIndex

      public Playlist getPlaylistAtIndex(int index)
      Getter for a specific playlist from the Listener's library based on an index. Before this method is run the user is printed a list of their playlists with the corresponding indexes provided.
      Parameters:
      index - an integer provided by the user representing their desired playlist. The index is validated before being passed to this method.
      Returns:
      Playlist object of the desired playlist
